Hair Color.snpedia_context: The risk allele is rs1805008(T), compared with the wild-type rs1805008(C) allele. rs1805008, known as Arg160Trp or R160W, is one of several SNPs in the MC1R gene associated with red hair color (redheads), in this case in an Irish population although this has also been reported in Icelandic and Dutch populations .
This missense mutation influences red hair color and has been in the Spanish maternal ancestry of User:Corpas son.

Skin Color.description: Genotype TT -- no specific interpretation curated
Skin Color.snpedia_context: Influences appearance associated with skin pigmentation in two samples of East Asian ancestry and it confirms previous evidence indicating that evolution towards light skin occurred, at least in part, independently in Europe and East Asia. each rs1800414(C) was associated with a 1.3 melanin unit reduction in skin pigmentation. This SNP accounts for 9% of the variation in skin color seen in the study population.

Skin Color.description: Lighter skin -- derived European/South Asian allele at SLC24A5, the largest-effect skin color locus known
Skin Color.snpedia_context: The allele, A111T, rs1426654(A), indicates light-skinned West Eurasian ancestry. This SNP influences skin pigmentation. [PMID 16847698, PMID 16357253] It appears as if this SNP is a relatively new one in human evolution; one estimate is that the rs1426654(A) allele, in other words, light skin pigmentation, spread through the European population around 6,000 - 12,000 years ago.
